verdict.rationale: Mobile apps are a fair question for a personal-assistant product, but the evidence never documents an official iOS or Android app. It shows only a web app, a desktop app, and messaging channels such as phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email and Slack. A community user asking whether Android support is planned suggests there is no Android app.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android
